scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: You sent three messages to the customer, but he didn't reply to any of them.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Do you think he doesn't want to buy anymore? No, it's your message that makes him not want to reply to you.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: What kind of messages are you sending? Have you considered the last proposal? Or is there a recent promotion I want to share with you?

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Translated into plain language, it's just one sentence: Do you want to buy it or not? The customer knows that as soon as he replies to you, you will start selling.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: So the safest way is to not read or reply. Do you know how top sales people follow up?

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: In their follow-ups, 80% is unrelated to business. A good article share, a greeting, a piece of sincere concern.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: Psychology calls this the mere exposure effect. When someone is more familiar with you, they are more likely to have a good impression of you.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: You don't need to do anything special, you just need to keep appearing in his world, but without giving pressure.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Data shows that 80% of transactions occur in the fifth to twelfth contact. If you give up at the third time, you will lose 80% of your performance.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: So what is the top-level sales? It's that you feel I am always by your side, yet I am not there.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Leave a comment with the words 'follow-up', and I will private message you the complete SOP. Change selling to concern, change pressure to value. I am your guide, leading you to understand human nature and close high-value deals.
